# Browser dependencies

Three.js **0.169.0** and its matching addons are served locally so the
simulator needs no CDN requests at runtime. Both are distributed under the MIT
license in `three/LICENSE`; upstream license headers are retained.

Unmodified upstream files:

- `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.169.0/build/three.module.min.js`
- `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.169.0/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js`
- `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.169.0/examples/jsm/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js`
- `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.169.0/LICENSE`
